field.label: MCC
field.help: Define the Mobile Country Code (MCC) for the network.

field.label: MNC
field.help: Define the Mobile Network Code (MNC) for the network.

field.label: TAC
field.help: Define the Tracking Area Code (TAC) for the network.

field.label: Network Name
field.help: Define the Service Provider Name (SPN) for the network.

field.label: Slice/Service Type
field.help: Define the Slice/Service Type (SST) for the network.

field.label: s1ap
field.help: Define the S1AP or N3 IP address to bind to the MME or AMF service.

field.label: ue
field.help: Define the max number of UEs (User Equipment) supported by the network.

field.label: Peer
field.help: Define the max number of eNB or gNB hosted radios.

field.label: 4G
field.help: Enable 4G SA provisioning for the network.

field.label: 5G
field.help: Enable 5G SA provisioning for the network.

field.label: 5G NSA
field.help: Enable 5G NSA provisioning for the network.

field.label: UPF
field.help: Enable just UPF provisioning for the network.
